name: gcc-mods
description: gcc's passive surfaces inside the Claude Code TUI: clickable absolute paths, a resume offer after a clear, the context gauge in the status line, and wakes for an idle session.

startOn.title: Start on
startOn.description: Turn the mod on in every new session. Off: a session starts with the mod silent, and /hub on turns it on for that session.

hygiene.title: Transcript hygiene
hygiene.description: Clickable absolute paths and compact seat and peer rows in the transcript.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.description: Resume offer after a clear or resume, context and usage gauge, insert-/core-dump button past 70 percent.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Gate and ready counts from the goal record, and the continue offer when the agent stops with agent-ready rows open.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Track sub-agent seats for a landing toast, a running count in the spinner, and the unread-report wake.

wake.title: Wake
wake.description: Pending decision page in the band; wake an idle session when a decision-page answer lands.

mailWake.title: Mail wake
mailWake.description: Also wake an idle session for new ipc mail. Off by default: claude-ipc has its own delivery and this is only a layer over it.
